title: Briefroom intake: compact CS ask capture + initial cost proxy
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and CS funnels surface a high volume of enterprise feature asks with inconsistent detail. PMs spend >2h per request on manual synthesis before a scoping call, slowing responsiveness and losing momentum with prospects.

Proposal: Ship a lightweight 'Briefroom' intake artifact and a 5-field initial cost proxy that CS can populate (or the customer can fill directly). The Briefroom is a small form + auto-generated short brief that creates a concise summary for PM review, plus a first-pass economic lens (banded cost estimate and complexity signals). The goal is to reduce PM synthesis time to <30m and provide consistent signals for prioritization gating.

Scope (what's in):
- A short form (6 fields) embedded in the CS playbook and optional link for customers.
- Auto-briefer: templated summary saved to Linear and Confluence link.
- Initial cost proxy: bands (Quick: <2w, Scoped: 2-6w, Large: >6w) with drivers mapped to effort (integration, UI, infra, data).
- Quick econ snapshot: estimated ARR uplift / impact bucket (low/medium/high) — filled by CS with PM validation.
- Readout card in the Enterprise intake board (Linear) with labels and assignment suggestion.

Out of scope: full PRD, engineering estimates, design mocks beyond 1-line acceptance criteria.

Why this helps: Standardizes first pass, surfaces consistent signals for roll-up reporting (heatmaps), speeds handoff to PMs and lowers friction for customers to articulate priority.

User stories:
- As a CS rep, I want a single form to capture core details so I can hand off a scorable brief quickly.
- As a PM, I want a one-page briefing that includes an initial effort band and customer economic signal so I can rapidly prioritise.
- As a sales AE, I want to share the form with a prospect and have the customer-provided context auto-attach to the ticket.

Metrics for success:
- PM average initial synthesis time reduced from >120m to <=30m.
- % of enterprise asks with economic band filled rises to 80% within 8 weeks.
- Time to first response (CS->PM) under 48h for briefs submitted via Briefroom.

Acceptance criteria: see acceptance_criteria field.

Rollout plan: pilot with two AE teams (platform & fintech), collect feedback for 2 sprints, then expand to all CS.

Notes: This is intentionally minimal and designed to be iterative. The initial version will be a Google Form + zapier flow to create a Linear issue and attach the auto-brief. Longer-term we'll embed form in Console and connect to customer metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Briefroom form exists (6 fields) and can be submitted by CS or customer link
Submission creates a Linear ticket with templated brief in the description and labels applied
Initial cost proxy (Quick/Scoped/Large) is presented as a required field and saved to the ticket
PM triage time for pilot cohort reduced to <=30 minutes for new briefs
Pilot feedback captured in Confluence doc and iteration action list created
